title: Publishable item sidecar
description: The JSON sidecar (sidecar.json) beside each item a producer offers through publishable-output 1.0 (owned by the publishing module): an item is a directory <kind>/<id>/ (kind site or podcast) holding the producer's files and this sidecar. tlp is the producer's CLAIM: the gate excludes anything above its ceiling, re-derives the marking from the content (a TLP marker in the body raises the label; a deny-listed name, a secret shape or posture language blocks it) and checks every file's sha256 before anything leaves the lab. The files named in sha256s are exactly the files present; nothing else is accepted.
